title: Braised White Bean and Sausage Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with Brazilian sausage, white beans, and a hint of warmth from stew seasoning.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the stew seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white beans, warm water, and cooked sausage to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
